profile.name: Theodore Roosevelt Presidential Library
profile.tagline: Inspiring leadership, conservation, and courageous citizenship through the life and legacy of Theodore Roosevelt.

items.headline: The Roosevelt Family
items.blurb: Meet the Roosevelt family — TR's six spirited children, a family tree from New Amsterdam to two presidents, and the young niece named Eleanor.

items.headline: Theodore Roosevelt's Rise to Power
items.blurb: Trace Roosevelt's climb from Rough Rider to the White House — San Juan Hill, a vice presidency meant to sideline him, and the fateful autumn of 1901.

Roosevelt and the Conservation Story
items.blurb: Roosevelt's conservation story told in numbers and his own words — some 230 million acres of forests, parks, and refuges protected for the future.
